name: python-release
description: Handle Python SDK release, build, bump, packaging metadata, PyPI client pin, uv.lock, nox/build workflow, and publish verification changes. Use for Python release process work or dependency pin bumps; do not use for ordinary Python feature implementation.
author: ComposioHQ
summary_zh: 一套用于管理 Python SDK 版本发布、构建打包、依赖锁定和发布验证的流程工具，适合发布维护与依赖升级场景。
